note: Maps rebuilt with nrs-large depth (same poses, keyframes and recipe as the SGM32 maps; only depth differs). Sizes and counts from each staged map folder by tools/update_maps_json.py; names, routes, credits, licences and limits unchanged from the SGM32 build.

maps.title: A street in India
maps.source: Recorded by Necessity Robotics with its own OAK-D-Lite camera.
maps.limitation: Camera poses come from xclean's live output in a real-time (paced) replay of our OAK-D-Lite recording (no ground truth exists for this route). Where the route passes the same roads twice, the two passes are not checked against ground truth, so some surfaces may appear doubled or soft; our loop closures moved the second circuit by up to 9.3 m.
maps.engine_note: Camera poses: xclean's live output in a real-time (paced) replay, from the median run of the three final-board runs (by ATE on routes with ground truth; on OAK routes, the run whose end position is closest to the other two), not ground truth.
